text:
mika: quick kickoff for ACME POC. Short goals: confirm auth, SDK examples, quotas, streaming behavior, and success criteria. Can owners call dibs?

todd: I can handle SDK + streaming snippets. Note: we prefer SSE; websockets possible but need proxy. Streaming cancels on client disconnect.

anya: I'll own auth/security. NDA + SecQ v2 required before we enable SSO. We support OIDC and SAML. Need their IdP metadata.

rachel_acme: ACME will send IdP metadata and prompts today. Also need a temporary usage cap so we don't exceed credits.

infra_bot: INF-4720 created: provision small dedicated pool (1x A10-class) with burst policy. Quotas suggested: 40 rps, 300k tokens/day.

todd: SDK snippet (python):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
with c.stream("chat") as s:
  for part in s:
    print(part.text)
# idempotency for rest calls: idempotency_key param
```

mika: acceptance criteria draft: P95 latency < 350ms, stream stability > 99%, cost < $0.02/1k tokens effective, eval pass >= 80% on provided gold set.

anya: ack. I'll send SecQ and SOC2 excerpts. Also confirm log retention expectation — hosted default 90 days unless they request 180.

rachel_acme: we prefer hosted with KMS and 180 days. Also confirm retry guidance for SDK.

todd: client-side exponential backoff + idempotency keys. Example: retries=3, base=250ms, max=3s, jitter=true. Server dedupe window 24h.

mika: timeline: NDA+SecQ by 11:00, IdP+prompts by 14:00, infra done by 16:00, smoke tests 16:30. Ack owners?

anya: ack.

todd: ack.

rachel_acme: ack from ACME. We'll upload docs.

mika: great, attaching INF-4720 to the POC ticket and will follow up with pricing note. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
